descriptions: The biggest update yet: a full redesign, GTA's settings and key bindings inside the pause menu, a new map locations list, and support for every game build.
New design — the whole pause menu is redesigned (header, player info, map card, announcements and settings) on top of a dark, blurred view of the game.
Added a live map card on the main page showing your current position. Open Map takes you to the full map.

Added GTA settings inside the pause menu — every settings tab (Gamepad, Keyboard/Mouse, Audio, Camera, Display, Graphics, Advanced Graphics, Voice Chat, Rockstar Editor) in the pause menu's style, with Save / Reset, an unsaved-changes prompt, a description for every setting, a video memory bar and live game view for graphics, GTA's own questions shown in the menu's dialog, and background tab loading so tabs open instantly.
Added key bindings inside the pause menu — all GTA and FiveM key bindings with search. Click a key, press the new one, done. FiveM binds are grouped by resource.
Added a map locations list — GTA's map legend in the pause menu style, with search, a switcher to step through every blip of the same type, and a controls bar (Enter sets a waypoint).
Admins can now create and delete announcements from the pause menu with the new + Create button. Admins are your framework's admin group or anyone with the command.bablopausemenu_admin ace.
Works on every game build, from the oldest builds up to 3889. The resource picks the right files for your sv_enforceGameBuild by itself when it starts, with no setup.
Smoother menu with higher FPS while it's open.
Added a short cooldown that stops visual bugs from spam-opening the menu (Config.OpenCooldown).
Added English and German translations for everything new.
Fixed the screen blur staying on after closing the menu (ESC spam or leaving the map, mostly at low FPS).
Fixed waypoints appearing or moving by themselves when opening the map from the pause menu.
Fixed the menu getting stuck when the server took too long to answer.
Removed a leftover debug line from the server console.

New config: Config.OpenCooldown (seconds between opens, 0 = off), Config.Settings (Mode, HideNativeMenu, GraphicsSections, FiveMKeysName, Preload) and Config.MapLegend (turns the map locations list on or off).
Config.CustomButtons is now empty by default; the Quit button is kept as a commented example.

New colors.css variables: --map-overlay (dark layer over the map card) and --backdrop-game (how much of the game shows through the dark background, 0–1, default 0.055). Icons now follow --global-surface and --global-dark.
When updating: replace the whole folder, copy your own values into the new config.lua (it has new options), and add the two new variables if you keep your old colors.css.
Players should restart FiveM once after the update so the new settings and map screens load.
Needs ox_lib and oxmysql.
